name: Crimson Frontier: Youth
source:
You play as Adam Crimson, the son of a captain in a military unit fighting crime.

His father raises him with strict military discipline, moving from one service apartment to another and never staying in one place for long. None of this helps Adam make friends or become a model student at school.

As corporations intensify their struggle for spheres of influence in space, a Resistance movement begins to emerge within society.

Who will you become in this story? You are not yet a hero - just a young man caught in the heart of a time of change.
Will you follow your father's path, or choose your own road?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4486770]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演亚当·克里姆森——一名打击犯罪军事部队上尉的儿子。

父亲以严苛的军纪将他抚养长大，带着他从一间军属公寓搬到另一间军属公寓，从未在任何地方长久落脚。这种颠沛流离的生活既没能让亚当交到朋友，也没能让他成为学校里的模范优等生。

随着各大商业巨头在太空领域的势力范围争夺战愈演愈烈，一股反抗军运动开始在社会暗流中悄然崛起。

在这段故事里，你最终将成为怎样的人？眼下的你还算不上什么英雄——只是一个被卷入时代变革漩涡中心的普通青年。
你会追随父亲的足迹，还是走出属于你自己的道路？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4486770]Steam[/url]]
